annotations.title: Read where a form's uploads land

description: Report this form's upload destination: the per-form choice, the stored config, and the `resolved` provider uploads actually reach right now (which can be the workspace default or Fillo's transit staging when the form itself picks nothing). Read it before changing it. Needs storage:manage — this reports the workspace resolution a write would change.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.
